    [mild] diamonds: the first trichotomy #

    For a mild contour C with ρ = ω' ≫ α and ω' not invertible, the D̃₅ diagram of [mild] figure 2.5 (first diagram) is not cleaving in P/τ. Hence γ = ξ ≫ ω', or ω' = g ≫ γ, or α ≫ ω' = η ≫ γ, or β ≫ ω' = η ≫ γ (MildContour.diamond_cases).

    The star Ẽ₆ at y (arms along v, along w, and the tail ω' ≫ α) shows that v or w has length at most two (MildContour.star_e6).

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.MildContour.diamond_cases {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] [IsFiniteRayCategory P] {k : Type u_1} [Field k] [Infinite k] {x y : P} (C : MildContour x y) (hM : MildHyp k P) {ω' : y ⟶ C.sv} (hω' : ¬CategoryTheory.IsIso ω') (hρ : C.ρ = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ω' ↑C.α) :
    (∃ (g : x ⟶ y), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g ω' = C.γ) ∨ (∃ (g : y ⟶ x), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g C.γ = ω') ∨ (∃ (g : (RayVert.mk C.sv).out ⟶ x), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g C.γ = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (↑C.α) ω') ∨ ∃ (g : (RayVert.mk C.sw).out ⟶ x), CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp g C.γ = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (↑C.β) ω'

    [mild] figure 2.5: the trichotomy of the diamond case.

    ∃ (c : RayVert P) (d : RayVert P) (e₀ : a ⟶ c) (e₁ : c ⟶ d) (r : Quiver.Path d b), p = ((Quiver.Path.nil.cons e₀).cons e₁).comp r

    Splitting off the first two arrows of a path of length at least two.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.MildContour.star_e6 {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] [IsFiniteRayCategory P] {k : Type u_1} [Field k] [Infinite k] {x y : P} (C : MildContour x y) (hM : MildHyp k P) {ω' : y ⟶ C.sv} (hω' : ¬CategoryTheory.IsIso ω') (hρ : C.ρ = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ω' ↑C.α) (hv : 2 ≤ C.v'.length) (hw : 2 ≤ C.w'.length) :
    False

    The star Ẽ₆ at y: if ρ = ω' ≫ α with ω' not invertible, then v or w has at most two arrows.
